=== common.UnovaLacunosaTale
from a trainer with lines of their own
way -
  Anyone> There's a great, great hole in the land behind this town. Long ago a huge meteorite fell out of the sky, and that was what made it.
  Anyone> Something frightening was sleeping inside the meteorite. On cold nights it woke, and a freezing wind rolled down into the village.
  Anyone> Whatever the wind touched turned to ice, and the people hid in their houses until the sun came up again. That's why we keep indoors after dark, even now.
  Anyone> Believe it or not, as you please. But the people of this town stay inside at night to this day. Old stories shape our lives.
